Physics hand-checked: from R = ρl/A, resistivity is the resistance of a conductor of unit length and unit cross-sectional area; ρ = RA/l; unit ohm metre; dimensional formula [M L³ T⁻³ A⁻²] as the book prints; ρ depends only on the material and its temperature.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The definition
lines: Resistivity is the resistance of a conductor
of unit length and unit area of cross
It depends only on the material of the
conductor and its temperature, not on the
length or thickness of the piece.
steps.margin_note: First mark. Both conditions — unit length AND unit cross-sectional area — must appear.
steps.why: Resistance R = ρl/A mixes the material with the shape of the piece. Setting l = 1 and A = 1 removes the shape, leaving a number that belongs to the material alone.
common_mistakes: Writing only resistance of unit length and dropping unit area.
Saying resistivity changes when the wire is cut or stretched. It is a material property; only R changes.

recall.must_convey: That resistivity is the resistance of a conductor of unit length and unit cross-sectional area, a property of the material.
accept: resistance of unit length and unit area
resistance of a unit cube of the material
reject: rho equals R A by l

steps.memory_tip: Two units in one sentence: unit length and unit area.

steps.label: Formula and unit

lines.text: ρ = RA/l, unit: ohm metre (Ω m)

steps.margin_note: Second mark. Formula with the unit Ω m; the dimensional formula is a safe extra line.
steps.why: Rearranging R = ρl/A isolates the material constant. The unit follows from the rearrangement: ohm times square metre divided by metre gives ohm metre.
common_mistakes: Writing the unit as ohm per metre. It is ohm metre.
Writing ρ = Rl/A. The area goes on top: ρ = RA/l.

recall.must_convey: That rho equals R A by l, with unit ohm metre.
accept: rho equals R A by l
from R equals rho l by A
reject: resistance of unit length and unit area

steps.memory_tip: Flip R = ρl/A: the area climbs up, the length goes down — ρ = RA/l.

insider_note: The unit ohm metre (not ohm per metre) is the detail examiners check on this definition.
